animation.simpleMeaning: moving pictures made from many still images
animation.contextMeaning: the method that makes separate pictures look alive

frame.simpleMeaning: one single picture in a moving sequence
frame.contextMeaning: one picture used to build animated movement
frame.sentence: Each image is called a frame.

motion.contextMeaning: the moving action created by many fast pictures
motion.sentence: At that speed, the motion feels smooth.

timing.simpleMeaning: when something happens and how fast
timing.contextMeaning: the speed and rhythm of movement in a scene
timing.sentence: That is why timing matters so much.

pose.simpleMeaning: the position of a body at one moment
pose.contextMeaning: one important body position in an action
pose.sentence: Artists drew a character pose, then drew the next pose, and then the next one.

clay.simpleMeaning: soft material you can shape with your hands
clay.contextMeaning: a material used to make moving figures
clay.sentence: A cartoon can wave, a game character can run, and a clay figure can jump.

stretch.contextMeaning: change shape to make movement feel stronger
stretch.sentence: A face can stretch more than a real face would.

squash.contextMeaning: a shape change that shows force or impact
squash.sentence: Another classic technique is squash and stretch.

blink.simpleMeaning: close and open your eyes quickly
blink.contextMeaning: a fast eye movement that makes a character feel real
blink.sentence: If you have ever watched a character blink or turn their head, you have already seen this trick at work.

illusion.simpleMeaning: something that seems real but is not
illusion.contextMeaning: the false feeling of real movement from still pictures
